page.overview:
Who is Johnny Cage's Movie Director?

The Director appeared briefly in the 1995 film Mortal Kombat. He was the director of Johnny Cage's latest movie before his entry into the Mortal Kombat Tournament.

While shooting the movie, the other actors repeatedly forgot their cues. Upset by this, Cage refused to continue the shoot and argued with the director before walking off the set in frustration.
